decisive_items: Transvaginal ultrasound demonstrated an 18 cm diameter ovarian tumor
a large, fluid-filled lesion measuring 19.3 × 6.2 × 21 cm, located in the pelvis and mid-abdomen, displacing the uterus and compressing the aorta and inferior vena cava
The lesion appeared unilocular with a 1.5 mm wall and no septations or solid components
response.rationale: The imaging features—a large, unilocular, thin-walled, fluid-filled cyst without septations or solid components—are classic for a benign ovarian cystadenoma, most consistent with serous type. A fibroma would be solid, and mucinous cystadenomas typically show multilocularity or septations, which are absent here.

rejected.why: Mucinous cystadenomas often present as multilocular or septated cysts; the unilocular, non-septated appearance makes this less likely.
Ovarian fibromas are solid tumors; the lesion is described as fluid-filled with no solid components, which contradicts this diagnosis.
